# Consolidated packet test checklist

Newer entries supersede only the named branches in earlier source milestones.
Every new case remains written only; implementation coverage is not acceptance.
Current source classification is 176 partial / 0 unsupported of 176 tracked routes;
older count snapshots below are historical. No route is verified complete.

## Familia first-reward request durability

- [ ] CURRENT SOURCE ONLY / PARTIAL / UNTESTED:
  `familia/first_reward/receive` now stores every accepted transport identity
  with the actual received-body hash, settled Familia creation generation,
  lifetime reward operation, request-time pending/settled state and exact
  response/hash. Exact requests resolve before generic cache and sequence
  handling. While operation 22300 remains pending they recover the one
  canonical ticket handoff. Once the exact cumulative target and native
  operation signature are saved, an integrity-checked observation projects an
  empty remaining-effect operation through hot retry and cold confirmation;
  the immutable queue and real ACK remain required. After ACK, the request
  returns an empty settled response rather than redelivering the ticket.
- [ ] Player-wide receipt terms, operation shape, original four-star ticket,
  cumulative acquisition floor and pending/done exclusivity are revalidated
  on every request. An exact old identity after disband/recreation resolves
  only through its proved dissolution archive and cannot attach itself to or
  mutate the replacement Familia. Changed bytes, damaged request/response or
  reward evidence, and legacy generic cache-only success refuse with the
  lifetime receipt, ticket and current group retained.
- [ ] Execute the extended
  [test_familia_first_reward.cjs](../tools/test_familia_first_reward.cjs) and
  [test_familia_break.cjs](../tools/test_familia_break.cjs) only after every
  packet: receipt/request/reply rollback, cache deletion and restart, exact
  pending and post-ACK replay, new settled identities, response corruption,
  observation rollback/corruption/signature mismatch, cold remaining-effect
  confirmation, exact legacy split-save migration, legacy-cache refusal,
  event-clock movement and archived-
  generation replay after recreation. WRITTEN ONLY / NONE RUN; original
  quantity provenance, natural eligibility and native effect/save/ACK ordering,
  UI/performance/no crash/freeze/ANR remain incomplete or unverified; 176
  partial / 0 unsupported / 0 verified complete.
